binding.entry: FoundationReadonlyExecutor reuses DirectReadonlyExecutor validation, resource budget, bounded fetch, process execution lock, interrupt and deadline loop
binding.reader: FoundationReader.resolve_on on connector.session(read_only=True); access.sales supplies pinned physical relations
binding.reason: Live reader was never opened because the host guard blocked before metadata/data access
binding.projection: Private in-memory temporary views sales_document and sales_line, SAP_B1_HANA OINV/INV1, active August 2026 invoices and four explicitly authorized reference SKUs
binding.model_authority: No model-controlled physical paths, namespaces, credentials, projections or permissions; sealed logical catalog only
binding.authorization: Explicit owner-authorized local supervised UID, DEV-only source-scoped permission; not Console RBAC or shared-service accreditation; FULL_ACCESS alone denied
binding.limits: 1 thread, DuckDB memory 512 MiB, no spill, query 2 seconds, SQL total 10 seconds, 5 queries, 100 output rows and 64 KiB per result; preflight before live access
binding.external_access: Canonical DuckLake reader requires trusted external metadata/file access. Arbitrary model file/network functions are structurally rejected; this is not OS confinement
binding.join_limitation: Conservative published row bounds exceed the existing 10000-pair join budget. Joins may be rejected. No budgets were raised to force acceptance; row-reference verification joins independently in Python
binding.concurrency: CLI reuses existing UID-scoped interprocess investigation lock; SQL process lock inherited. No distributed service coordination
